# Sollemdev Portfolio & Systems Labs

> Personal engineering portfolio, system architecture cases, and privacy-first software products by Sollemdev.

## Projects

- [Babel — AI In-Place Translation Extension](https://sollemdev.github.io/projects/babel/): High-speed Manifest V3 Chromium browser extension for instant in-place text translation and AI prompt engineering directly inside any input field via hotkeys.
  - **Architecture**: Manifest V3, Service Workers, Content Script injection, DOM Text Mutation Observer, Zero-Data Retention (Client-Side Only).
  - **Multi-Model Support**: OpenAI (GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Haiku), DeepSeek, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash / Pro, Groq, OpenRouter, and Local Ollama instances.
  - **Ecosystem**: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, Opera GX, Vivaldi (with future native Windows/macOS/iOS/Android roadmap).
  - **Dictionaries**: 23 localized UI dictionaries with cross-platform native vector glyphs.

## Core Capabilities
- Web Extensions Architecture (Manifest V3, Service Workers, Content Script Injections)
- LLM Prompt Engineering & Local Client-Side Context Extraction
- Zero-Retention & DLP Privacy-First Architectures
- High-Performance Web Frontend Engineering
